title: Balancing Work and Life
subtitle: CDI 4.B.01
text: Learn how people manage their work, home, and personal time. Discover strategies to avoid burnout and protect your wellbeing.

title: Introduction
text: Life can feel busy — school, work, family, hobbies, and personal time all compete for attention. Some people manage it naturally, others need strategies to avoid feeling exhausted. This is called work-life balance.

title: In This Lesson
text: You will explore how different people manage their time, practical strategies to protect wellbeing, and how to prevent burnout and stress.

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain what work-life balance means
I can identify routines and boundaries that help manage time
I can describe how burnout can be prevented
I can choose practical techniques to use in my own life

title: Key Words
bullets: Burnout – Feeling exhausted from doing too much work
Boundaries – Limits we set to protect our time and wellbeing
Routine – A regular way of organising time and responsibilities

title: Quick Question
text: Imagine a person who works full time, cares for family, and wants time for hobbies. What problems might they face? How could they organise their day to feel less stressed?

title: How People Balance Work and Life
bullets: Setting boundaries – saying no to extra tasks or protecting personal time
Creating structured routines – planning daily and weekly schedules
Prioritising tasks – deciding what is most important first
Scheduling rest – making time for breaks, sleep, and relaxation
Delegating when possible – asking others for help

title: Complete the Sentence
sentence: People use different ______ to manage responsibilities and avoid ______.

title: Activity: Evaluating Time Management
text: Explore how different people balance their responsibilities and consider which techniques could work best for you.

title: Well Done
text: Everyone organises life differently. Clear routines and boundaries protect wellbeing and productivity. Planning your time today builds habits that help you succeed in the future.
